scope: Pure execution workers and the Rust process resolver

checks.sourcePolicy: All new source and test files have fewer than 500 lines.

verified: Four bundled mjs entries start directly with Node without a TypeScript loader or source entries.
The compiled Pi worker uses the real SDK and completes a tool round trip against a local synthetic model.
The compiled document worker parses synthetic CSV bytes and the computer worker serves an authenticated temporary loopback health request.
The generated production lock retains exact versions and integrity hashes, excludes tsx and business-server modules, and rejects credential-bearing dependency URLs.
Rust prefers a valid released bundle and rejects an invalid bundle rather than silently falling back.
Document parser cancellation, dropped callers, deadlines and excessive output reap the child before releasing capacity.
limits: Execution tests used existing SDK dependencies linked into a temporary artifact. A clean production npm install was not performed.
The computer smoke check did not launch a browser, desktop, virtual machine or real account.
No real model endpoint, formal database or user document was used.
Browser binaries and native desktop prerequisites are separate deployment requirements.
